title: Repairs, recalls, and unresolved fixes
summary: Reviews in this topic center on problems being fixed or awaiting repair, with several complaints about delays, unresolved recall issues, and uncertainty over whether fixes will last.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe long repair times, dealer-directed follow-up for unresolved problems, and vehicles returned after issues were fixed only after inconvenience.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention requests to get issues fixed, recalls, quick repairs, and doubts about whether a fix will hold, but the brief fragments do not consistently show a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most fragments are very short status-style statements, which limits confidence in interpreting customer sentiment beyond the assigned labels.
This topic mixes completed repairs, requests for repairs, and recall mentions, so the subject is operationally related but not fully uniform.
The sample is small and sentiment is often undetermined, so examples are insufficient for stronger conclusions about the broader ownership experience.
